rationale: MoE expert checkpoint metadata stores dp_world_size instead of seq_dp_world_size; loader uses wrong divisor and slices the wrong fragment. Detection: checksum of MoE expert param post-load must equal the fragment that the same rank wrote at save (anti-example 7: detected at load). Layer is schema_topo_precond — precond guards 'MoE module + sequence_parallel_size>1' and the equality is per-rank (save fragment vs load fragment), not pure cross-rank replication. P1 over P3: not 'all DP ranks should agree' but 'this rank's loaded value should equal this rank's saved value'. Tier 0 since param_checksum suffices.
